  ((CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.title') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.venue') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 2 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.cityId') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 4 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.startDate') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 8 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.endDate') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 16 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.latitude') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 32 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.longitude') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 64 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.locationPrecision') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 128 END)+(CASE WHEN json_type(p.data,'$.source') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 256 END)) AS marker_fields FROM performances p LEFT JOIN bookmarks b ON b.performance_id=p.id WHERE p.classification='performance' AND p.end_date>=? AND p.start_date<=? ORDER BY p.start_date DESC,p.id DESC
